author: Rory Robinson
title: Patriots coach engaged to NFL reporter after Mike Vrabel and Dianna Russini scandal - NewsBreak
text:
By Rory Robinson ,
1 hours ago New England Patriots special teams coordinator Jeremy Springer and NBC Sports Boston host Kayla Burton are engaged after the former proposed on June 19 at Swami's Beach in San Diego, California.
The pro sports couple shared the news four days later on Instagram, giving Patriots fans a much happier love story after months of attention surrounding the organization over a separate coach-reporter controversy.
Springer and Burton have been publicly dating since 2024, according to reports. The same year, both became more closely tied to the NFL and the New England sports scene professionally. Meanwhile, a text message from Russini about the scandal was published after she explicitly asked to be kept off the record.
• Major clues hint at MSG wedding for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce as NYC takes big step
• Dianna Russini upset bosses with 'unacceptable conduct' on podcast
The Patriots hired Springer in January 2024, while Burton joined NBC Sports Boston as an on-air host and reporter that July. While the Pats' special team leader dedicates his time to the NFL organization, Burton is tasked with providing reporting for the Patriots, Boston Red Sox, Celtics, and Bruins.
The couple announced the engagement with photos from the beach proposal and a simple caption that read: "yes in every lifetime."
The post showed Burton accepting the proposal along the California coast as the two celebrated a relationship that had gradually become public through social media.
• Taylor Swift flashes ring while singing with a surprise guest at Travis Kelce event
• Dianna Russini left behind astonishing salary after Mike Vrabel scandal
Several high-profile stars voiced their congratulations, including fellow media star Joy Taylor, her WNBA sister Veronica Burton, AEW superstar Swerve Strickland, and other WNBA athletes including Kate Martin and DiJonai Carrington.
Burton later shared an Instagram story on Wednesday night showing her grandmother her ring. The newly engaged reporter earned her gran's approval instantly and reacted to the diamond with one word of awe: "wow."
Their relationship went fully public in September 2024, when Burton first shared a photo of the two together. They later spent Christmas together in Cape Cod, and Springer publicly celebrated Burton's 30th birthday during June 2025 with photos and the caption: "I love you."
The engagement comes after published photos in April that appeared to show Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel and NFL reporter Dianna Russini together at a resort in Sedona, Arizona.
Later images from 2020 added to the scrutiny around the reported relationship after they were shown kissing at a bar in New York City. The fallout became a major off-field distraction after Vrabel's first year back in New England, which ended with a Super Bowl run.
Russini later resigned from her role as a senior NFL insider at The Athletic amid questions about professional boundaries, as the company was conducting an investigation. Additional reports have suggested that Russini was earning $800k a year at the company before her departure.
